description: Comparison tolerances for contracts/reference fixtures. Values are derived from the Phase 1 measurements of both implementations (see CHANGELOG 0.1.0), with headroom.

positions_mean_equinox_arcsec.note: Moon includes pre-1972 Delta-T handling differences (1950 epoch). Mean-equinox longitude = Horizons true-equinox longitude - nutation_longitude_deg.

non_ephemeris_grade.ceres: Rust: bundled codes_300ast segment in ECLIPJ2000_DE405 is not rotated (known issue KC-1, must warn). Python: two-body MPC elements (must warn outside 5 years of the element epoch).
non_ephemeris_grade.chiron_python: Python computes Chiron from two-body MPC elements; Rust uses a Horizons-sampled Type 13 SPK.

moon_phase_note: USNO rounds phase times to the minute (|dt| <= 30 s); Moon-Sun elongation changes ~0.51 arcsec/s.
